title: S3 Gloss White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Schuberth S3 Gloss White is engineered for everyday agility, rapid ventilation, and effortless usability, pairing agile street ergonomics with certified multi-impact protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1434g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~87 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by a glove-friendly Micro-Lock Ratchet retention system for confident all-day riding.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Universal fit with adjustable cheek pads; requires specific head shape for optimal seal.

technical_analysis: Features Direct Fiber Processing (DFP) glass fiber reinforced with carbon matrix tuned in Magdeburg acoustic wind tunnels paired with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna. The interior utilizes Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Schuberth S3 Gloss White: combining Germany 🇩🇪 craftsmanship with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna and Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Schuberth S3 Gloss White: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Schuberth S3 Gloss White. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Schuberth's Full Face lineup, the S3 Gloss White brings German engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Schuberth S3 Gloss White represents Schuberth's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Schuberth S3 Gloss White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
